QuestInfo.name: The Roots of Regret
QuestInfo.0: I should visit #b#p313##k in #b#m010002000##k. He seems deeply troubled by something...
QuestInfo.1: #b#p313##k, whom I met in #b#m010002000##k, asked me to collect #b25 vials of #t04031093##k from the #r#o35#s#k in the forest. He needs them to find the source of the magical disturbance.
QuestInfo.2: I handed the vials of #b#t4031093##k to #b#p313##k. He confirmed that an ancient seal has fractured, and something buried long ago is waking up.

0.0: Ah, it is you. I can see in your eyes that you feel it too. The ground beneath us is trembling with an ancient resonance.
0.1: I have my suspicions about what is causing it, but I need proof. Decades ago, a subterranean realm known as the #b#m010006000##k was sealed away to contain a terrible rot. I fear that seal is cracking.
0.2: The #r#o35#s#k hoard anything steeped in dark magic. If the seal is leaking, they will have gathered vials of #b#t4031093##k, and so much of it in one place creates an interference that blocks my senses.
0.3: Hunt the #r#o35#s#k and bring me #i04031093# #b25 vials of #t04031093##k. Once they are out of the forest, the interference will clear. Will you assist an old scholar?

yes.0: A brave choice. Gather the resonance and return to me with your report.\nKeep your wits about you. Magic of this nature is highly volatile.

no.0: You are wise to be cautious. Magic of this nature is not a toy. Return when your resolve is steady.

1.0: You have returned. I felt the magical interference in the forest lift slightly as you collected those vials.\nLet me see them now...
1.1: ...I see. The energy now flowing freely from these vials carries the unmistakable signature of the #b#m010006000##k.
1.2: You have done well to clear the path for me. Catch your breath for a moment... because if my senses are correct, we are about to learn a truth we are not yet prepared to face.

item.0: You haven't gathered enough vials of #b#t04031093##k.\nThe magical interference is still too thick for me to see through. Return when the task is done.
